title: Implement backbone-to-LoRa path transition (spec 7.4)
description: Implement configurable thresholds for backbone-to-LoRa path transition per spec/05-routing.md 7.4. Parameters: PATH_SWITCH_HYSTERESIS, PATH_SWITCH_HOLD_TIME, PREFER_LORA. Prevents flapping when node is near boundary between backbone and direct LoRa paths.
